description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure: it is the Crossref "Check for updates" publisher badge (a graphical logo). It consists of a circular emblem on a plain light-grey/white background with a faint partial rectangular border at the upper-right corner. At the centre of the circle sits a red bookmark/ribbon shape with a notched lower edge, flanked by two thick arc segments — a blue arc sweeping over the upper and right side and a yellow/orange arc over the lower-left side; a small white gap separates the two arcs at the lower left. Directly beneath the emblem the words "Check for updates" are printed in black sans-serif type, set on two lines ("Check for" above "updates"). There are no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no panel letters, no annotations and no numerical values anywhere in the image. The badge carries no microstructural, diffraction, spectroscopic, mechanical-property or compositional information and cannot support or refute any claim about the Fe–20Mn–9Al-1.5C–2Ni–3Cr low-density steel or its S1000, S1050 and MHT heat treatments. It is a metadata artefact, not a data figure.
